```go
package mapfluent

import (
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type segment struct {
	key     string
	index   int
	isIndex bool
	append  bool
}

func parsePath(path string) []segment {
	path = strings.TrimSpace(path)
	path = strings.TrimPrefix(path, "$")
	path = strings.TrimPrefix(path, ".")
	if path == "" {
		return nil
	}
	var segs []segment
	var b strings.Builder
	flushKey := func() {
		if b.Len() > 0 {
			segs = append(segs, segment{key: b.String()})
			b.Reset()
		}
	}
	for i := 0; i < len(path); i++ {
		c := path[i]
		switch c {
		case '\\':
			if i+1 < len(path) {
				i++
				b.WriteByte(path[i])
			}
		case '.':
			flushKey()
		case '[':
			flushKey()
			end := strings.IndexByte(path[i:], ']')
			if end < 0 {
				b.WriteByte(c)
				continue
			}
			inner := path[i+1 : i+end]
			i += end
			if inner == "" || inner == "-" {
				segs = append(segs, segment{isIndex: true, append: true})
			} else if n, err := strconv.Atoi(inner); err == nil {
				segs = append(segs, segment{isIndex: true, index: n})
			} else {
				// quoted key e.g. ["a.b"]
				segs = append(segs, segment{key: strings.Trim(inner, `"'`)})
			}
		default:
			b.WriteByte(c)
		}
	}
	flushKey()
	return segs
}
```

Wait `end := strings.IndexByte(path[i:], ']')` gives offset relative to i. inner = path[i+1:i+end]. Then i += end moves i to the position of ']'. Loop increments i, so next char after ']'. Good.

Edge: `["a.b"]` inner is `"a.b"` then trim quotes. Good. Also `['a.b']`.

```go
func (m M) Get(path string) any {
	return getSegments(map[string]any(m), parsePath(path))
}

func getSegments(node any, segs []segment) any {
	cur := node
	for _, seg := range segs {
		switch n := cur.(type) {
		case map[string]any:
			if seg.isIndex {
				return nil
			}
			v, ok := n[seg.key]
			if !ok {
				return nil
			}
			cur = v
		case M:
			if seg.isIndex {
				return nil
			}
			v, ok := n[seg.key]
			if !ok {
				return nil
			}
			cur = v
		case []any:
			if seg.isIndex && !seg.append && seg.index >= 0 && seg.index < len(n) {
				cur = n[seg.index]
			} else {
				return nil
			}
		default:
			return nil
		}
	}
	return cur
}
```

```go
func toFloat(v any) (float64, bool) {
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case float64:
		return x, true
	case float32:
		return float64(x), true
	case int: ...
	case json.Number:
		f, err := x.Float64()
		...
	case string:
		f, err := strconv.ParseFloat(strings.TrimSpace(x), 64)
		return f, err == nil
	default:
		rv := reflect.ValueOf(v)
		if rv.IsValid() {
			switch rv.Kind() {
			case reflect.Int...:
				return float64(rv.Int()), true
			case reflect.Uint...:
				return float64(rv.Uint()), true
			case reflect.Float...:
				return rv.Float(), true
			}
		}
		return 0, false
	}
}
```

```go
func (m M) Set(path string, value any) M {
	segs := parsePath(path)
	if len(segs) == 0 || segs[0].isIndex {
		return m
	}
	if m == nil {

	setInto(map[string]any(m), segs, value)
```

```go
func setInto(node map[string]any, segs []segment, value any) {
	seg := segs[0]
	if len(segs) == 1 {
		node[seg.key] = value
		return
	}
	next := segs[1]
	child, ok := node[seg.key]
	if next.isIndex {
		arr, ok2 := toSliceAny(child)
		if !ok2 {
			arr = []any{}
		}
		arr, _ = setSlice(arr, segs[1:], value)
		node[seg.key] = arr
		return
	}
	childMap, ok := toMapAny(child)
	if !ok {
		childMap = map[string]any{}
	}
	setInto(childMap, segs[1:], value)
	node[seg.key] = childMap
}
```

setSlice:
```go
func setSlice(arr []any, segs []segment, value any) ([]any, bool) {
	seg := segs[0]
	idx := seg.index
	if seg.append {
		idx = len(arr)
	}
	if idx < 0 {
		return arr, false
	}
	for len(arr) <= idx {
		arr = append(arr, nil)
	}
	if len(segs) == 1 {
		arr[idx] = value
		return arr, true
	}
	next := segs[1]
	if next.isIndex {
		child, ok := toSliceAny(arr[idx])
		if !ok { child = []any{} }
		child, ok = setSlice(child, segs[1:], value)
		if !ok { return arr, false }
		arr[idx] = child
		return arr, true
	}
	childMap, ok := toMapAny(arr[idx])
	if !ok { childMap = map[string]any{} }
	setInto(childMap, segs[1:], value)
	arr[idx] = childMap
	return arr, true
}
```

toMapAny and toSliceAny handle M and map[string]any, []any, []string maybe.

Delete:
```go
func (m M) Delete(path string) M {
	segs := parsePath(path)
	if len(segs) == 0 || segs[0].isIndex || m == nil {
		return m
	}
	deleteInto(map[string]any(m), segs)
	return m
}

func deleteInto(node map[string]any, segs []segment) {
	seg := segs[0]
	if len(segs) == 1 {
		delete(node, seg.key)
		return
	}
	child, ok := node[seg.key]
	if !ok { return }
	next := segs[1]
	if next.isIndex {
		arr, ok := toSliceAny(child)
		if !ok { return }
		if deleteSlice(arr, segs[1:]) {
			node[seg.key] = arr
		}
		return
	}
	childMap, ok := toMapAny(child)
	if !ok { return }
	deleteInto(childMap, segs[1:])
	node[seg.key] = childMap
}
```

```go
func deleteSlice(arr []any, segs []segment) bool {
```

```go
func deleteInto(node map[string]any, segs []segment) {
	seg := segs[0]
	if len(segs) == 1 {
		delete(node, seg.key)
		return
	}
	child, ok := node[seg.key]
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	next := segs[1]
	if next.isIndex {
		arr, ok := toSliceAny(child)
		if !ok {
			return
		}
		if newArr, ok := deleteSlice(arr, segs[1:]); ok {
			node[seg.key] = newArr
		}
		return
	}
	childMap, ok := toMapAny(child)
	if !ok {
		return
	}
	deleteInto(childMap, segs[1:])
	node[seg.key] = childMap
}

func deleteSlice(arr []any, segs []segment) ([]any, bool) {
	seg := segs[0]
	idx := seg.index
	if idx < 0 || idx >= len(arr) {
		return arr, false
	}
	if len(segs) == 1 {
		out := make([]any, 0, len(arr)-1)
		out = append(out, arr[:idx]...)
		out = append(out, arr[idx+1:]...)
		return out, true
	}
	next := segs[1]
	if next.isIndex {
		child, ok := toSliceAny(arr[idx])
		if !ok {
			return arr, false
		}
		newChild, ok := deleteSlice(child, segs[1:])
		if !ok {
			return arr, false
		}
		arr[idx] = newChild
		return arr, true
	}
	childMap, ok := toMapAny(arr[idx])
	if !ok {
		return arr, false
	}
	deleteInto(childMap, segs[1:])
	arr[idx] = childMap
	return arr, true
}
```

parts.text:
Set up module `mapfluent` at the repo root (Go 1.21). `gofmt`, `go build`, `go vet`, and `go test` all pass.

Layout:
- `mapfluent.go` — `Map` type, `New`/`From`/`FromAny`/`Of`, `Get`, `GetOr`, `Has`, `Keys`, `Len`, `Raw`
- `path.go` — dot/bracket path parser: `a.b.c`, `a.b[0].c`, `[-]`/`[]` append, `\.` escaping, quoted `["a.b"]`
- `value.go` — `lookup` plus fluent typed accessors `String`, `Int`, `Int64`, `Float64`, `Bool` (variadic defaults + `*OK` variants), `Object`, `Array`, `Strings`
- `mutate.go` — chainable `Set`, `SetDefault`, `EnsureMap`, `Delete`, `Merge` (deep), `Clone` (deep)
- `json.go` — `Decode`/`DecodeString`/`MustDecode`, `Encode`/`EncodeIndent`
- `mapfluent_test.go` — full coverage

Usage:
```go
m := mapfluent.New().
    Set("user.name", "Ada").
    Set("user.tags[-]", "admin")

name := m.String("user.name", "unknown")     // "Ada"
m.EnsureMap("meta").Set("active", true)       // chain into created sub-map
m.Delete("user.tags[0]")
data, _ := m.Encode()
```

All names are safe on a nil `Map`, and numeric/bool/string getters coerce common types (including JSON's `float64`).
